items.name: hardware
items.title: Hardware
items.description: Sets a project up for the hardware kit: the <Hardware> root, the skin's stylesheets, the IBM Plex Mono font, and the page-wide behaviors the components rely on (haptics, interaction sounds, keyboard-only focus rings, a block caret and Safari's Tab order).
items.author: Shu Ding <https://x.com/shuding>
items.docs: Wrap your app (or any part of it) in <Hardware> from @/components/ui/hardware; everything inside is styled by the skin. Set keyColor={{ l: 0.64, c: 0.31, h: 48 }} for an orange-red key color. IBM Plex Mono is imported at the top of your CSS file.
